2010-01-12: Wyclef Jean set up an appeal to help survivors of the Haiti earthquake.
A devastating earthquake struck Haiti, claiming tens of thousands of lives and destroying much of the country's infrastructure.
Around 200,000 people are thought to have died in the Haiti earthquake with 1.5 million Haitians now believed to be homeless.
The UN launches an appeal for $562m to help victims of Tuesday's devastating earthquake in Haiti .
A major earthquake struck Haiti, destroying the presidential palace and other buildings in Port-au-Prince and causing hundreds of deaths.
A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Haiti, prompting the Cornwall-based charity ShelterBox to mobilize response team members from the UK and USA to assess aid requirements.
Rescuers began pulling survivors from the wreckage of the UN headquarters in Port-au-Prince following a devastating earthquake.
2010-01-13: A major earthquake struck Haiti, toppling buildings and leaving victims buried under rubble, with many feared dead.
A major earthquake struck Haiti, causing widespread devastation in Port-au-Prince and prompting international rescue and aid efforts.
2010-01-14: Between 100 and 150 people from the UN's 9,000-strong peacekeeping mission in Haiti are still missing after the earthquake, with 16 peacekeeping soldiers and police known to have died.
The US is mounting one of the biggest relief operations in its recent history to help victims of the earthquake in Haiti, with the Red Cross estimating up to 50,000 people killed.
Footage emerges showing the moment Haiti was shaken by an earthquake, captured on what appears to be a security camera in Port-au-Prince.
The US is sending up to 3,500 soldiers and 2,200 marines to Haiti to help rescue efforts in the wake of the devastating earthquake.
Haitians living abroad struggle to contact relatives after communication systems in Haiti were badly damaged by this week's earthquake.
2010-01-15: The BBC discontinues its live coverage page for the night as hopes of finding survivors in the rubble fade and the focus shifts to getting urgent aid into and around Haiti following Tuesday's earthquake, in which tens of thousands are feared killed and some three million displaced.
UK charities prepare to deliver aid to Haiti following an earthquake that is thought to have killed over 100,000 people.
2010-01-16: UK charities are scrambling to get aid to Haiti after a 7.0-magnitude earthquake, with up to 50,000 people feared dead and over three million displaced.
2010-01-17: Rescue teams searching through the rubble of Haiti's earthquake continue to find people alive, including a man pulled from the wreckage of the national tax office by an Israeli team.
2010-01-18: The US military begins airdropping food and water supplies into earthquake-hit Haiti.
Violence and looting broke out in parts of Port-au-Prince, almost a week after the earthquake hit Haiti, as police fired gunshots to disperse looters.

The United Nations describes the Haiti earthquake as the worst humanitarian disaster it has had to confront in its history, with large numbers of survivors forced to fend for themselves because insufficient aid is getting through.
2010-01-19: Former US President Bill Clinton visited Haiti to observe the international aid operation at Port-au-Prince airport as UN special envoy, having been assigned by President Obama to raise private-sector money for Haiti.

Frustration grows at the slow pace of relief efforts in earthquake-hit Haiti, sparking fears that survivors' desperation may lead to violence, while the US begins airdrops of essential supplies despite earlier ruling this out.
2010-01-20: The US sends another 4,000 sailors and marines to Haiti for the earthquake relief effort, increasing the number of US troops involved to about 16,000.
A strong magnitude 6.1 aftershock rocks Haiti eight days after a devastating earthquake, sending people into the streets, with damage extent not yet known.
2010-01-21: Haiti announces plans to house 400,000 earthquake survivors in new tented villages outside Port-au-Prince, with 100,000 initially to be sent to 10 settlements near Croix Des Bouquets.
2010-01-22: A stick-wielding gang attacked Haitians waiting for aid at a food distribution center on the outskirts of Port-au-Prince, while aid drops began reaching rural parts of Haiti.
US navy and army divers are to start repairing the pier at Haiti's main port on Friday to help get emergency aid to millions in need after the earthquake .
2010-01-23: A 23-year-old man was pulled alive from the rubble of a ruined hotel in Port-au-Prince, 11 days after the earthquake, as the official search for survivors was declared over.
2010-01-24: A government minister says the confirmed death toll from Haiti's devastating earthquake has risen above 150,000 in the Port-au-Prince area alone, while many more bodies remain uncounted under rubble.
2010-01-25: Concern is growing about poor sanitation and disease spreading among the hundreds of thousands made homeless almost two weeks after the devastating earthquake hit Haiti, with violence ongoing in the slums of Cite Soleil.
